Sprechen or Besprechen? German A2 Verb-Pattern Practice

Compare über etwas sprechen with etwas besprechen in German. Practise prepositions, direct objects and verb forms through translated examples and answers.

A2 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Understand the difference

Über ein Thema sprechen means to talk about a subject; ein Thema besprechen means to discuss a subject. Sprechen can also mean speaking a language. Besprechen normally takes the matter as a direct accusative object, without über in this standard pattern. The meanings can overlap, but the object structure differs.

Common mistake to avoid

Use Wir besprechen den Plan, or Wir sprechen über den Plan. Do not mix the two standard patterns into Wir besprechen über den Plan.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Wir sprechen über das neue Kursangebot.We are talking about the new course offering.
Worked example 2Wir besprechen das neue Kursangebot.We are discussing the new course offering.
Worked example 3Meine Cousine spricht drei Sprachen.My cousin speaks three languages.
Worked example 4Die Gruppe bespricht den nächsten Arbeitsschritt.The group discusses the next work step.

Practice: choose the right word

Choose sprechen or besprechen according to the supplied sentence structure. Conjugate for the subject; keep the given preposition. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. Wir ___ über die geplante Feier. (talk about)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: sprechen

Über introduces the topic with sprechen.

Question 2. Wir ___ die geplante Feier. (discuss directly)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: besprechen

Besprechen takes die geplante Feier directly as its object.

Question 3. Er ___ fließend Deutsch und Tamil. (speak languages)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: spricht

The er form of sprechen is spricht.

Question 4. Sie ___ den Vorschlag mit dem Team. (discuss; singular sie)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: bespricht

Besprechen has the singular form bespricht and takes den Vorschlag directly.

Revise it so it sticks

Return to this lesson tomorrow and complete the four gaps without looking at the rule. Then write two of your own sentences using today's pattern. Check whether the subject, case and verb position match the explanation.
